reports.title: Financial Report Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. 20263rd. quarter

desk.headline: Net profit ARS 229.0bn against a year-ago loss, but down 16% on Q2 as rates fell; no guidance

numbers.eps_basis: net income per share, ARS (inflation-adjusted, IAS 29)

other.label: Net income attributable to Grupo Galicia
other.change: vs ARS 117.0bn loss in Q3 2025; -16% q/q

results: Grupo Galicia earned ARS 229.0bn (ARS 142.6 a share) after a loss a year ago, a 9.3% return on equity; all figures are adjusted for inflation.
Profit fell 16% from Q2 as lending rates and returns on inflation-linked bonds dropped; net interest income was down 13% on the quarter.
Costs fell 31% from a year ago after merging the former HSBC Argentina business, taking the efficiency ratio to 39.4% from 59.6%.
Bad-debt charges fell 21% year on year and the NPL ratio eased to 9.7% from 10.6% in Q2, though it is still above last year's 6.9%.
Main earners were Banco Galicia (ARS 134.9bn), the asset manager (ARS 48.5bn) and Naranja X (ARS 29.3bn); the capital ratio was 23.5%.

guidance.summary: The quarterly report gives no financial guidance or outlook.

watch: Whether lower interest rates keep squeezing margins, or loan growth makes up for it.
Loan quality, especially at Naranja X, where the NPL ratio is 17.8%.
Management comments on the 25 Nov call about loan growth and credit costs.
